items.description: Pure city-timezone date-window engine with no UI change: preset-to-window rules for All, Today, Tonight, Tomorrow, This weekend, Next 7 days, This month, Custom (weekend [Fri 17:00 incl, Mon 00:00 excl), Tonight start-time-only >= today 17:00 and < tomorrow 00:00, DST by wall-clock, past-start clamp, horizon truncation, 180-day cap, end-before-start coerces to single-day) plus URL encode/decode (custom pair wins, partial/invalid ignored, unknown keys fall back to All, past start clamps with rewrite). Done when: table-driven unit tests over stubbed clock and stubbed city timezone cover the weekday table, DST, Tonight boundaries, month-end, clamping, caps, coercion, and preset/window round-trips; no UI, feed, scraper, prefetch, or backend change. No blockers; foundation for all tickets below.
items.title: Date tabs 1: city-TZ window engine + URL codec (#104)
items.notes: Done: added xmlui/date-windows.js (pure, Intl-only, no deps) with resolveDatePreset, resolveCustomRange, encodeDateParams, decodeDateParams; 34 table-driven tests in xmlui/test.html Date windows group over stubbed now/timeZone (weekday table, DST 23h/25h, Tonight bounds, month-end, clamp+rewrite, 180-day cap, coercion, preset/custom round-trips) pass via node harness 34/34; pytest 97 passed; make lint clean (ruff+4 checkers). Decisions (unattended, pre-approved): preset keys all/today/tonight/tomorrow/weekend/next7/month, custom encodes as from/to only; clamp applies to Custom/URL decode only (preset windows computed from today never stale; clamping would destroy the Sat/Sun enclosing weekend); 180-day cap and coercion custom-only; horizon truncation uniform; Tonight carries startTimeOnly flag with matcher left to #106; no prod wiring (shell.js/Main.xmlui untouched) so zero UI change — #105 wires the engine. Browser Playwright run of test.html not available in-loop; exact block executed under node instead.

items.description: Visible tab strip for All, Today, Tomorrow, Next 7 days, This month with the legacy slider deleted outright (no dual UI). Tapping a tab commits instantly: one committed absolute window feeds both the rendered list and the pager, paging resets and scroll-to-top fire on commit only, active tab always reflects the window, commit syncs the URL with history-replace while preserving sibling params. Date composes with search and category; category counts reflect the date window; Picks and Dashboard ignore the window. Done when: all five windows correct in city timezone, slider gone, URL round-trips plus All-strip, reload restores, Back leaves the calendar, static chrome checks pass. Blocked by: #104. Tonight, Weekend, Custom arrive in later tickets.
items.title: Date tabs 2: tab strip for day presets, slider removed (#105)

items.description: Tonight and This-weekend tabs on the existing strip via the intraday stage: Tonight is start-time-only from 5pm city-time (16:59 and all-day events excluded, multi-day on start day only); weekend is [Fri 17:00 incl, Mon 00:00 excl) city-time with Mon-Thu resolving to the upcoming weekend and Fri/Sat/Sun to the enclosing one, DST by wall-clock. Both commit instantly, show pressed state, sync evergreen links resolving relative to the opening day and instant, and compose with search and category. Done when: Tonight boundaries and the full weekday/weekend table including DST verify against live data in the browser checklist. Blocked by: #104, #105.
items.title: Date tabs 3: Tonight + This-weekend intraday presets (#106)

items.description: Custom tab with the stock range date picker behind it: date-only yyyy-MM-dd format, city timezone, today minimum with past dates disabled, explicit confirm enabled (no auto-commit, no per-tick filtering), boot-computed forward presets (Next 7, Next 30, This-month-remainder, recomputed at boot plus day-rollover). Confirming commits the absolute window, marks Custom active, syncs the canonical exact-date link (from/to only, no preset key). Past starts clamp with URL rewrite; ends past the horizon clamp with the truncation label; inverted ranges coerce to single-day; malformed or partial input is ignored; 180-day cap holds. Done when: confirm-once behavior, forward presets, clamp/rewrite, truncation label, and custom-link round-trips verify; no bundle rebuild or pipeline change. Blocked by: #104, #105.
items.title: Date tabs 4: Custom range picker + custom links (#107)

items.description: Informative states and navigation hardening across all windows: empty state reads `No events {windowLabel}.` with a `Show next 7 days` button that commits Next 7, syncs the URL, and moves focus to the tab-strip heading without scrolling; horizon overrun reads `Showing through {horizonDate} — the calendar currently ends there.` below the tabs; unknown keys and malformed pairs fall back to All with stable reload; embedded calendar shows the identical filter UI with embed plus date params round-tripping together; city selection stays a push while date stays a replace so Back after city-plus-date leaves the calendar; All clears only date keys. Done when: every state above verifies in the browser checklist with siblings preserved throughout. Blocked by: #105, #106, #107.
items.title: Date tabs 5: empty, truncation, embed, Back hardening (#108)

items.description: Invoke the code-review skill against the work completed in this loop, then append the findings as agent follow-ups IN THE SAME LOOP ITERATION. Fixed point: origin/main (three-dot diff origin/main...HEAD on branch feat/103-improved-date-filtering). Standards axis: repo conventions plus the skill's smell baseline. Spec axis: the original spec in issue #103. Report under ## Standards and ## Spec without merging the axes, ending with per-axis totals and worst issue per axis. Do NOT fix code in this item; fixes happen in later loops under tdd and disciplined-engineering. After the report, translate every non-deferred finding into a new follow-up item appended to this prd.json: one finding per item, each small and one-task shaped with reviewer-judgeable done criteria, each carrying title, description, passes:false, reference (the #103 spec line or the owning ticket #104-#108), and priority 10, 20, 30, ... in dependency order (spec-correctness before standards-polish, dependencies first). Findings closable only by human acceptance in issue #109 (keyboard-only completion, screen-reader pressed announcement, focus and Escape discipline, count-on-commit, 360px wrap, full live-data browser checklist) are NEVER appended — itemize them as deferred-to-#109 in notes instead. Never append a second review item; the review runs once. Done when: the two-axis report is in notes (every Spec finding quoting its #103 line, deferred-to-#109 list included) AND all non-deferred findings exist as appended follow-up items; then set passes:true on this item and stop. The loop continues onto the follow-ups by priority and may only emit COMPLETE when they are all passes:true.
items.title: Date tabs review: code-review against spec #103 + append agent follow-ups, #109 deferred (code-review skill)
